job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced LLM Research Engineer to join our team at PREDII INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in research engineering and be able to work independently.

Roles and Responsibility
Conduct research and develop new methods and processes to improve existing products and systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.
Design, develop, and test prototypes and proof-of-concept projects.
Analyze data and results to draw conclusions and make recommendations.
Develop and maintain technical documentation and reports.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Job Requirements
Strong understanding of research principles and methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
